LightningComponentBundle.description: Flow screen component: an application's checklist as rows grouped by category, each with its own upload, status and Board comments. Returns the items given a file; the flow sets them to Pending.

property.name: applicationId
property.label: Application Id
property.description: The Individual Application or Business License Application whose checklist to show.

property.name: includeCategories
property.label: Show Only Categories
property.description: Comma-separated category developer names to show, for example Payment. Blank shows every category.

property.name: excludeCategories
property.label: Leave Out Categories
property.description: Comma-separated category developer names to leave out, for example Payment.

property.name: allowSentToBoard
property.label: Allow Sent to the Board Uploads
property.description: True when staff use the screen, so documents sent to the Board by mail or another state can be uploaded when they arrive.

property.name: uploadedItemIds
property.label: Uploaded Item Ids
property.description: Checklist items that had a file attached on this screen.
